body: High-level: We will need regression tests for the extraction of normative rules from the ISA manual, especially since they are not copied into UDB

Overall:

- Please add sorbet signatures to all of the new Ruby files.
- I'm still concerned that pulling the latest from riscv-isa-manual makes this approach fragile. Is there any way you can add a commit hash to keep the two repos synced? Or use a submodule?
I may have a use-case for this with an AI approach to access documentation. What's stopping this PR is the backend code to support the tagging?
